title: Expand no-fallback lint to catch .get(key, "")
description: Follow-up to the .get(key, {}) check added in PR #1206. Add .get(key, "") detection to lint_no_fallback.py — empty string defaults hiding missing keys. There are ~256 existing violations across the codebase. Each must be individually reviewed: fix the ones where the key should always be present (use data["key"]), suppress with # nofb where the field is genuinely optional. Do this incrementally in small reviewable PRs.
